data.one_liner: Package to replace diacritics and accents with equivalent characters.
data.what_it_does: Removes accents and diacritics signs from a string by replacing them with an equivalent character using a simple function call.
use_when: You need to strip accents and diacritics from text strings
You are building search or filtering logic that needs to be accent-insensitive
avoid_when: You need complex internationalization or localization frameworks
strengths: Simple and straightforward usage with a single main function
Supports a wide range of accented characters across multiple languages
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted only to removing diacritics
